_comment: Defines which physical printer handles which job role. 'role' matches PrinterDevice.role on the backend (KOT / BILL / BOTH). USB_DIRECT = a USB receipt printer Windows installed with the generic WinUSB driver (not under Printers & scanners) — bytes go straight to the device; vendorId/productId (hex) pick it. For a printer that IS installed in Windows use type USB + windowsPrinterName (and share it); for a network printer use type LAN + ip/port.
